text.content:
A Grave-Cold room, unremarkable at a glance but part of the Barrows's larger pattern all the same.

GM Notes

Clue: A clue toward the floor's deeper story: the Bone Choir never got the burial it was owed, and it intends to make everyone still breathing understand why that matters.

Encounter: Roll a random encounter check when the party lingers here more than a few minutes - something has noticed them.
